summary: Our project, "How Satellites Save Our Earth", explores how satellites help monitor and protect our planet. It explains how satellites collect information about weather, climate change, natural disasters, forests and oceans. Through this project, we aim to show how satellite technology helps people understand environmental problems, prepare for disasters and protect Earth's natural resources.
details: Our project explores how satellites observe Earth and provide important information about our environment. It explains how satellites help monitor weather, track natural disasters, detect environmental changes and protect forests and oceans. This project aims to increase awareness of satellite technology and its role in keeping our planet safe.
